email_body_classification_enforced.title: Email Body Sensitivity Classification Enforced
email_body_classification_enforced.description: Indicates whether the email system enforces formal sensitivity classification labels (e.g., Confidential, PII, Restricted) on outbound and inbound message bodies at ingestion or send time.

pii_scanning_enabled.title: PII Content Scanning Enabled on Email Bodies
pii_scanning_enabled.description: Indicates whether automated PII detection scanning (via DLP or content inspection engine) is actively applied to email message bodies to identify sensitive data at ingestion.

unclassified_email_retention_policy.title: Retention Policy Applied to Unclassified Emails
unclassified_email_retention_policy.description: The retention policy applied to email messages that carry no sensitivity classification label. Indicates whether unclassified emails are retained indefinitely, subject to a default retention period, or blocked.

retention_policy_enforced.title: Retention Policy Enforced
retention_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether an automated, technically enforced retention schedule exists for email server data, with defined deletion triggers for PII-bearing messages.

maximum_retention_days.title: Maximum Retention Period (Days)
maximum_retention_days.description: The configured maximum number of days PII-bearing emails are retained before automated deletion or anonymization is triggered. A value of 0 indicates no defined limit.

pii_classification_labels_applied.title: PII Classification Labels Applied to Email and Attachments
pii_classification_labels_applied.description: Indicates whether sensitivity or PII classification labels are systematically applied to emails and their attachments, enabling policy engines to identify and act on PII-bearing messages during retention enforcement and access control.

mailbox_store_encryption_enabled.title: Mailbox Store At-Rest Encryption Enabled
mailbox_store_encryption_enabled.description: Indicates whether the email server's mailbox store (including attachment data) is encrypted at rest, preventing direct readability if storage media or files are accessed without authorization.

attachment_document_protection_enforced.title: Attachment Document-Level Protection Enforced
attachment_document_protection_enforced.description: Indicates whether email attachments carrying sensitive content have document-level protection applied (e.g., IRM/DRM, password protection, or rights management labels) so that attachment content cannot be read without an additional decryption or authorization step.

sensitivity_labeling_enforced_on_attachm.title: Sensitivity Labeling Enforced on Attachments
sensitivity_labeling_enforced_on_attachm.description: Indicates whether a mandatory sensitivity or classification label policy is enforced on email attachments containing PII, ensuring PII-bearing attachments are identified and subject to appropriate handling controls.

content_based_access_control_enabled.title: Content-Based Access Control Enabled
content_based_access_control_enabled.description: Whether the email platform enforces access restrictions based on message sensitivity labels or PII classifications, rather than relying solely on mailbox ownership.

shared_mailbox_pii_access_scope.title: Shared Mailbox PII Access Scope
shared_mailbox_pii_access_scope.description: The breadth of user access granted to shared mailboxes or delegated mailbox accounts that are known to contain PII data.

transfer_destination_recorded.title: Transfer Destination Recorded in Classification Record
transfer_destination_recorded.description: Whether the data classification record captures the geographic destination(s) of email relay nodes and archives used to route or store PII-containing emails.

cross_border_transfer_compliance_verifie.title: Cross-Border Transfer Compliance Verified
cross_border_transfer_compliance_verifie.description: Whether each identified cross-border email routing path has been verified against applicable data residency requirements (e.g., GDPR Chapter V adequacy decisions, SCCs, BCRs) and the verification is documented.

secure_erasure_policy_enabled.title: Secure Erasure Policy Enabled
secure_erasure_policy_enabled.description: Indicates whether a secure erasure policy is configured on the email server to permanently delete messages (including from recoverable deleted-items folders) after a defined period, preventing indefinite recoverability of PII.

backup_snapshot_pii_purge_policy.title: Backup Snapshot PII Purge Policy
backup_snapshot_pii_purge_policy.description: Describes whether backup snapshots containing email data are subject to a PII purge or erasure procedure aligned with data subject erasure rights. 'none' means no policy exists, 'manual' means ad-hoc procedures only, 'automated' means system-enforced purge.
